items: 3 medium shallots, thinly sliced (or 1 small onion)
1 tsp whole cumin seed (or cumin powder)
1 tsp whole coriander seed (or coriander powder)
3–5 Tbsp red curry paste (start with 3–you can always add more)
1½ cups baby potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces
2 large carrots, peeled and diced to ¼” thick
2–3 Tbsp coconut aminos or soy sauce
1 large chicken breast, cut to ½ × 1 × ¼” pieces

steps.title: Sauté the shallots
steps.body: Heat a large pot or Dutch oven on medium, and add **2 Tbsp coconut oil** and **3 medium shallots**, thinly sliced (or sub **1 small onion**). Saute for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Add the spices
steps.body: Add **1 tsp whole cumin seed** (or substitute cumin powder) and **1 tsp whole coriander seed** (or substitute coriander powder). Saute for another 2 minutes, stirring.

steps.title: Add the curry paste
steps.body: Add **3–5 Tbsp red curry paste** (start with 3–you can always add more). Stir to coat onions.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Add **1½ cups baby potatoes**, cut into bite-size pieces, and **2 large carrots**, peeled and diced to ¼” thick. Stir to coat vegetables, cook for 2 minutes, then add **2 × 14 oz cans light coconut milk**, **1½ cups water**, **¼ tsp ground cinnamon**, **1 dash each cardamom and nutmeg**, **2–3 Tbsp coconut aminos or soy sauce**, **1–2 Tbsp maple syrup** and **2 Tbsp peanut butter**.

steps.title: Add the liquid
steps.body: If needed, add enough liquid to cover vegetables. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce to a simmer.

steps.title: Add the chicken
steps.body: Add **1 large chicken breast**, cut to ½ × 1 × ¼” pieces.

steps.title: Finish the chicken
steps.body: Simmer until chicken is cooked, then add **1–2 Tbsp lime juice**.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Season to taste, adding more PB, curry, lime, soy sauce, or maple syrup as desired.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve over rice (may add coconut and sautéed onions to rice), and top with chopped roasted salted peanuts, cilantro and lime. Accompany with steamed bok choy.
